title: Mutivi wa Ndhambi Leyikulu
intro: Munhu loyi u yime tanihi phuphu ya ku tiyisela ku ringana malembe-xidzana yo tala, a vitana vanhu lava kanetaka ku ya eku vonakaleni ka ntiyiso loko va ri karhi va langutane ni ku hlekuriwa ni ku ariwa. Ku nga khathariseki swiphiqo leswikulu ni ku tika ka rungula leri hlanganisaka switukulwana, nandza loyi u tshame a tiyile eka vurhumiwa bya yena kukondza ku humesiwa xileriso xo hetelela.
clues: Ndzi hete malembe ya madzana nhungu na makume ntlhanu ndzi ri karhi ndzi vitana vanhu va mina endleleni ya ku lulama, vusiku ni nhlikanhi, exihundleni ni le rivaleni.
Ndzi tsundzuxe vanhu va mina hi nxupulo lowu vavaka, kambe va nghenisa tintiho etindleveni ta vona, va tifunengeta hi tinguvu ta vona hi ku tikukumuxa.
Ndzi lerisiwe ku aka nchumu lowukulu ehansi ka mahlo lama languteke ya Hosi ya mina, hambileswi a ku nga ri na mati lama vonakaka.
Loko ndzi ri karhi ndzi tirha, varhangeri va vanhu va mina va hundze va ndzi hlekula, kambe ndzi va byele leswaku ku nga ri khale hi ta va hi va hlekula.
Ndzi kombele nyama ni ngati ya mina leswaku swi ndzi joyina, kambe va hlawule ku lava vutumbelo entshaveni, va tshemba leswaku yi ta va ponisa eka xidzedze lexi a xi tlakuka.
Xikepe xa mina xi hetelele xi wisa eNtshaveni ya Yudi endzhaku ka loko misava yi mite mati ya yona naswona xibakabaka xi tshike mpfula ya xona.
arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
